beats.label: S1 · The case opens
beats.text: SEC's Spyros asks U.S. Attorney Chuck Rhoades to investigate hedge fund king Bobby Axelrod. Chuck's wife Wendy is Axe Cap's in-house therapist, making it a conflict from day one.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the central rivalry and the Wendy triangle that defines every season.

beats.label: S1 · Baiting the house
beats.text: Chuck goads Axe into buying an $83M beachfront estate to turn public opinion against him. Axe buys it anyway, and Hall confirms Chuck has opened a formal case file.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First direct move by Chuck; sets Axe on notice that this is now a war.

beats.label: S1 · Chuck burns his father
beats.text: Chuck discovers Chuck Sr. is running a short squeeze on Axe using inside info, and forces his own father to sell at a loss. The family rift becomes permanent.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Chuck's willingness to sacrifice family for the case defines his character going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Dollar Bill falls, Wendy pulls back
beats.text: Chuck's team arrests trader 'Dollar Bill' Stearn via a farmer flipped in Iowa. Wendy demands Chuck recuse himself; he lies and says he has.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First arrest inside Axe Cap and the first major lie between Chuck and Wendy.

beats.label: S1 · The plea deal collapses
beats.text: Axe agrees to plead, pay $1.9B and lose his firm, until Chuck adds a lifetime trading ban. Axe tears up the check and throws it in Chuck's face.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment settlement dies; from here only one man walks away standing.

beats.label: S1 · The 9/11 lie leaks
beats.text: Chuck leaks that Axe wasn't a hero on 9/11 but was trading through it, pocketing $750M as his partners died. Axe's public halo cracks and his family is pulled from school.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Destroys the folk-hero myth that had protected Axe and personalises the fight.

beats.label: S1 · Donnie was the play
beats.text: Bryan flips trader Donnie Caan, but Donnie was already dying and secretly working with Axe as a double agent. Donnie's death leaves the government's evidence poisoned and Wendy caught between the two men.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's biggest con and the setup for Chuck's endgame chase in the finale.

cliffhanger.text: Donnie's evidence is compromised, Axe knows Chuck lied about recusing, and Wendy is trapped between her husband and her boss. Chuck goes hunting for Axe personally, and the collision neither man can walk away from is finally here.
questions: Can Chuck salvage a case against Axe after Donnie was turned against him?
Will Wendy stay with Chuck now that his lie about recusal is out?
How far will Axe go to end Chuck once he knows the fight is personal?

characters.name: Bobby "Axe" Axelrod
characters.line: Billionaire founder of Axe Capital; a 9/11 'survivor' whose heroic story has just been exposed as a lie about trading through the attack for profit.

characters.name: Chuck Rhoades
characters.line: U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York; publicly recused from the Axelrod case but still secretly directing it behind Wendy's back.

characters.name: Wendy Rhoades
characters.line: In-house performance coach and psychiatrist at Axe Capital, and Chuck's wife; the one person both men trust, now doubting Chuck after his recusal lie.

characters.name: Bryan Connerty
characters.line: Chief Assistant U.S. Attorney running the Axelrod case day-to-day; increasingly uneasy with how far Chuck will bend the rules.

characters.name: Kate Sacker
characters.line: AUSA on the Axelrod team; ambitious, principled, quietly aiming at a political career of her own.

characters.name: Mike "Wags" Wagner
characters.line: COO of Axe Capital and Axe's closest lieutenant; the operational muscle inside the firm.

characters.name: Lara Axelrod
characters.line: Axe's wife; fiercely protective of the family, willing to intimidate anyone who threatens their name, as she did to the widow June.

characters.name: Chuck Rhoades Sr.
characters.line: Chuck's wealthy, imperious father; freshly humiliated after Chuck forced him to unwind an insider short on Axe at a loss.

characters.name: Hall
characters.line: Axe's private fixer and surveillance specialist; runs the firm's counter-intelligence, including the mole hunt that pinned blame on Pouch.

characters.name: Donnie Caan
characters.line: Axe Cap trader flipped by the government, secretly a double agent for Axe; dies of his hidden terminal illness, leaving Chuck's evidence in question.
